detail.longDescription: For the past few months I've been working on a new programming language for classic Macs called Clarus. The goal is to reduce boilerplate and abstract away the toolbox unless you really need to use it directly. It supports Appletalk and TCP/IP out of the box using a simple interface and compiles native 68k binaries. It is still a work in progress, but check it out! https:// github.com/vaelen/clarus . Also check out my BBS written in Clarus: https:// github.com/vaelen/m68k-bbs . # retrocomputing # mac # programming
